document: UI-02 route register (PRD §5, WP-00 exit artifact)
method: One entry per app/**/page.tsx, listed from the file system by scripts/ui/route-register.ts. Mechanical fields (pattern, file, shell, sharedComponents, handRolled, states, phone, rulerWired) come from a scan of each page and of the module components it imports, up to three imports deep, stopping at the shared layer (components/ui, data, forms, detail, modules, unsaved, charts) and skipping shell plumbing (components/navigation, i18n, layout, shell, auth, offline). Judged fields come from decision tables written after reading the pages: surface, template, scrollRegion and rulerPolicy from lib/ui/page-contract.ts, module and v2Status from the script; v2Reason states the rule that applied.

fields.surface: platform | group | company | personal | project | portal | system | public. No route has the portal surface: the repository has no external portal.
fields.shell: which layout draws the chrome: app-shell (company and group workspace), platform-shell, group-shell, public-site, auth, viewer, experience-editor, offline, none
fields.template: one of the PageTemplate values of PRD §26.3
fields.scrollRegion: the id of the element the page's content scrolls in and a ruler would control (PRD §26.3); null outside the shells, where a page scrolls itself and never carries a ruler
fields.rulerPolicy: eligible | never, by PRD §8.1; the width, height and section conditions are checked at run time
fields.sharedComponents: shared primitives and patterns reached by the page or by its module components
fields.handRolled: what the page (page) and its module components (components) draw themselves, as signal×count. Strong signals, which tokens cannot answer: raw-table, raw-field, literal-text-px, hover-motion, card-shadow, literal-radius, raw-hex. Partly answered: raw-button, literal-control-size (h-9, h-10, size-9, size-10), own-card, nesto-card-class, bg-accent, font-serif. Weak: rounded-full, uppercase-label. A class string that also carries a ds2: class is not counted.
fields.states: loading and error: the nearest loading.tsx and error.tsx; empty: how an empty result is shown, null when the scan found nothing
fields.phone: mobile-component (a phone presentation of its own, including DataTable's record cards), stacked-table (Table stack), or none (responsive layout only)
fields.tickets: ids in UI-02-tickets.json that cover the route
